DOP: indīvara n. [ ts ], the blue water-lily, Nymphaea stellata; the tree Cassia fistula ; Abh 552; 1003 (~aṃ mataṃ nīluppale uddālapādape); Vv 45:5 (~ānaṃ hatthakam ahaṃ adāsiṃ; cf Vv-a 197, 10 foll. : uddālakapupphahatthaṃ vātaghātapupphakalāpaṃ); Ja VI 536, 8* (saraṃ … ~ehi sañchannaṃ); Ap 20, 10 (~aṃ va jalitaṃ).
